name: trackify
description: Trackify web tooling orchestration (Vite + CMake artifacts)

scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.wasm:build: cmake --build build --target player backend_psx backend_snes backend_nez backend_n64 backend_vgm
scripts.wasm: npm run wasm:configure && npm run wasm:build
scripts.dev: npm run wasm && npm run assets:prepare && vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8137
scripts.build: npm run wasm && npm run assets:prepare && vite build
scripts.build:watch: npm run wasm && npm run assets:prepare && vite build --watch
